title: Osmium
description: Datapack that tweaks/adds loot tables and recipes.
body:
**Osmium** is a Minecraft Datapack which adds various Loot Tables and Recipes.
<details>
<summary>Recipes</summary>
  
  - Chainmail armor | Crafted like any armor but with chains
  - Cheaper Chains | Now only 3 iron nuggets in a straight line
  - Cheaper Netherite Upgrade | Switched the netherrack and diamonds in the original recipe
  - Cobweb | Place 5 pieces of string in a checkerboard pattern to get 4 cobwebs
  - Enchanted Golden Apple | The classic gold blocks + apple recipe brought back
  - String Dupe | Place one piece of string anywere and get 2
  - Trident | 2 prismarine shards on top of eachother in the middle, and the top row filled with prismarine crystals
</details>
